description: This file defines the setup wizard page for an ERP system, including configuration for domains, branding, organization details, and fiscal year settings. It contains functions for page load handling, slide setup, validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds change events for company name and abbreviation inputs, including validation and auto-abbreviation logic.

methods.name: validate_fy_dates
methods.description: Validates that the fiscal year start and end dates are valid and logically ordered.

methods.name: set_fy_dates
methods.description: Automatically sets fiscal year start and end dates based on the selected country and current date.

methods.name: load_chart_of_accounts
methods.description: Loads chart of accounts options based on selected country.

methods.name: charts_modal
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with a tree view of accounts, allowing expand/collapse actions.
